categories.main_business_segments: Beijing SuperMap Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in geographic information software (GIS) and spatial intelligence software. Its main business includes GIS foundational software, industry application software for sectors such as natural resources, urban construction, water conservancy, meteorology, and enterprise digitalization, as well as SaaS GIS online services. The company also focuses on emerging areas like AI integration, low-altitude economy, and commercial aerospace applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops proprietary GIS foundational software with six major technology systems including big data GIS, new generation remote sensing software, 3D GIS, geospatial AI, distributed GIS, and cross-platform GIS. It emphasizes cloud-native architecture, AI-driven spatial data processing, and integration of remote sensing and spatial intelligence. The production methods include software development, platform integration, and deployment of AI models tailored for geospatial data analysis and applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SuperMap serves government agencies, enterprises, and institutions across over 100 cities in China and more than 100 countries globally. Key markets include natural resources management, smart cities, urban planning, water conservancy, meteorology, energy, transportation, commercial aerospace, and enterprise digital transformation sectors. Customers range from public sector entities to private enterprises in industries such as finance, logistics, and manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with dedicated regional divisions covering East China, North China, South China, Central China, Northwest, Northeast, and Southwest regions. Internationally, it has a presence in over 20 countries with local offices and agents in Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas. It maintains partnerships and projects in countries including Japan, Saudi Arabia, and multiple Belt and Road Initiative nations.
categories.supply_chain_position: SuperMap operates primarily in the midstream segment of the software supply chain, developing core GIS foundational software platforms and industry-specific application solutions. It acts as a technology provider and system integrator, supplying software products and services that enable downstream application development and end-user digital transformation across various sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in AI integration with geospatial intelligence, developing the SuperMap AIF AI technology base and industry-specific AI applications like SuperMap Copilot. It focuses on advancing remote sensing GIS integration, 3D modeling automation, and low-altitude economy solutions. R&D efforts also emphasize strengthening domestic technology independence (Xinchuang), expanding SaaS offerings, and enhancing international market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through software product sales under permanent licensing and subscription models, industry application software sales, and SaaS subscription services. Additional income comes from technical consulting, system integration services, government contracts, and rental income from leasing idle properties. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and dividends from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SuperMap is a leading GIS software provider in China and ranks third globally and first in Asia according to ARC Advisory Group. It competes mainly with major international GIS software vendors, holding a dominant domestic market share since 2015. The company positions itself as a technology innovator with strong autonomous capabilities and a comprehensive ecosystem, differentiating through AI integration and deep industry expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SuperMap reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.5 billion, a 24.3% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 171 million. The company experienced challenges due to delayed customer demand and extended project acceptance cycles. Despite short-term setbacks, it maintains a total asset base of over RMB 4 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with a 25.44% R&D-to-revenue ratio, signaling a focus on long-term growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SuperMap emphasizes its strong autonomous innovation capabilities, offering secure, controllable, and high-performance GIS foundational software critical for national information security. Its products integrate advanced AI, remote sensing, and 3D spatial modeling technologies, providing a comprehensive spatial intelligence platform. The company’s extensive industry experience, broad ecosystem of partners and developers, and commitment to domestic technology independence differentiate it as a trusted provider for digital government, smart city, and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
